domains.Academies: Loading and caching the academies a user can switch between.
domains.AccessControl: Permission checks before showing a screen.
domains.Api: Failures of calls from the panel to the API.
domains.App: General panel events that have no better domain.
domains.Assignments: Homework a teacher sets on a lesson and the submissions it collects.
domains.Audios: Audio library actions in the manager panel.
domains.Auth: Sign-in, sign-out and token refresh in the panel.
domains.Branding: Applying an academy's branding to the panel.
domains.Dashboard: Academy manager dashboard: live money, enrolment, and plan figures.
domains.Financial: Financial reports and records in the manager panel.
domains.Gdpr: Cookie and privacy consent captured in the browser.
domains.Geo: Detecting the visitor's country for phone inputs.
domains.Images: Image library actions in the manager panel.
domains.Media: Video and file storage, transcoding and secure playback.
domains.Onboarding: First-run setup steps a manager completes to go live.
domains.Payments: Payment and transaction screens in the manager panel.
domains.Products: Product screens in the manager panel.
domains.RequestStorm: Client-side circuit breaker: one API route called far above human speed.
domains.Session: Loading and scoping the signed-in user's session.
domains.TeacherPayout: Off-platform teacher payouts a manager records from the dashboard.

events.Academies.FetchingStoreFinancialDataFail: Academies fetching store financial data failed.
events.AccessControl.AccessControlCheckFailed: Access control access control check failed.
events.Api.APIRequestFailed: API A P I request failed.
events.Api.AuthTokenRefreshErrorFailed: API auth token refresh error failed.
events.Assignments.CourseAssignmentSaved: Teacher created or updated the homework attached to a course lesson or season.
events.Dashboard.ReportExported: Manager downloaded the dashboard CSV report for the selected period.
events.Dashboard.ReportExportFailed: Dashboard CSV report failed to build or download in the browser.
events.Onboarding.SetupBannerDismissed: Manager dismissed the first-run setup checklist.
events.Onboarding.SetupBannerShown: First-run setup checklist shown on the dashboard.
events.Onboarding.SetupStepOpened: Manager opened a first-run setup step from the dashboard banner.
events.RequestStorm.Tripped: A single route exceeded the per-window hit limit in the manager's browser; protected routes force a sign-out and storage wipe.
events.Session.ScopeSessionToAnAcademyFailed: Session scope session to an academy failed.
events.Settings.ContactOtpSendFailed: Profile contact OTP request failed (cooldown, delivery, or validation).
events.Settings.ContactOtpSent: Manager requested an OTP to verify a new email or phone on the profile page.
events.Settings.ContactOtpVerified: Manager verified a new email or phone on the profile page.
events.TeacherPayout.Recorded: The manager saved a bank transfer to a teacher from the teacher money table.
events.TeacherPayout.TeacherAnswered: The teacher confirmed or rejected a recorded payout from the earnings page.
